title: Financial Engine V4
description: The project's settled commercial calculation system that produces Commercial Performance results from warehouse facts and published business rules.
formula: Sales = Σ priceWithDisc; Marketplace Fee = Sales − forPay; Revenue = Σ ppvz_for_pay; Estimated Tax = Tax% × Σ finishedPrice; Net Profit = Revenue − costs − Estimated Tax

title: Model B (Commercial Performance)
description: The primary commercial profitability model for historical reporting: money-flow from sales through expenses to Net Profit on the Dashboard and related reports.

title: Model C (Settlement Profit)
description: Settlement-oriented profit framing (historically Model C). Revenue = netForPay; Net Profit deducts logistics, storage, penalties, deductions, acceptance, product cost, and advertising. Marketplace fees are informational only.
formula: Revenue = netForPay; Net Profit = netForPay − Logistics − Storage − Penalties − Deductions − Acceptance − Product Cost − Advertising
exceptions: Marketplace Fees are informational only and must not be deducted in Model C.

title: Gross Sales
description: Gross merchandise sales for completed sales in the period, before subtracting returned sales in the Commercial Performance display story.
formula: Gross Sales = Σ priceWithDisc (completed sales, pre-return display)

title: Net Sales
description: Display sales after returns: Gross Sales minus Returned Sales. Used for seller-facing sales presentation; not a synonym for Revenue.
formula: Net Sales = Gross Sales − Returned Sales; Sales = Σ priceWithDisc

title: Revenue
description: In Commercial Performance, the seller's marketplace payable amount for the period — the commercial top line from which operating costs and Estimated Tax are reasoned toward profit.

title: Marketplace Fee
description: The marketplace fee take in the commercial fee story. Shown for understanding; not deducted again in Net Profit when already reflected before Revenue.
formula: Marketplace Fee = max(0, Sales − Sales API forPay)

title: Product Cost
description: Cost of goods attributed to sold units for the period, based on maintained unit costs.

title: Logistics
description: Marketplace logistics costs attributed to the selected period in Commercial Performance.

title: Storage
description: Marketplace storage costs for the period.

title: Acceptance
description: Marketplace acceptance (intake) operation costs for the period.

title: Penalties
description: Marketplace penalty amounts for the period.

title: Adjustments
description: Marketplace financial adjustments for the period, including advertising and other holds not classified as Fee, Logistics, Storage, Acceptance, or Penalties.

title: Advertising
description: Advertising/marketing spend. In Commercial Performance commonly included inside Adjustments when sourced from finance adjustments.

title: Estimated Tax
description: Historical reporting tax estimate on completed sales. In Commercial Performance: Tax Rate × Σ finishedPrice (Customer Paid). Smart Pricing uses a different base intentionally.
formula: Estimated Tax = Tax Rate × Σ finishedPrice (historical reporting / Financial Engine)
exceptions: Smart Pricing uses Tax Rate × (Sale Price − Marketplace Fee) — do not unify with reporting.

title: Net Profit
description: Commercial profit after Estimated Tax in Commercial Performance — the primary after-tax profitability KPI for historical reporting.
formula: Net Profit = Revenue − Product Cost − Logistics − Storage − Acceptance − Penalties − Other/Adjustments − Advertising − Estimated Tax

title: WB Settlement
description: Settlement-oriented view of marketplace payout figures for reconciliation. Distinct from Commercial Performance; not a replacement commercial P&L.
exceptions: Revenue (Commercial Performance) ≠ Settlement Amount / Seller Payout.

title: Return Handling
description: Returns affect the sales story (Gross Sales, Returned Sales, Net Sales) and related quantities. They do not redefine Revenue into Customer Paid or Net Sales.

title: priceWithDisc
description: Wildberries Sales API seller-discounted unit price. Basis for Sales = Σ priceWithDisc on completed sales. Stored as wb_sales.price_with_disc. Not finishedPrice or forPay.

title: finishedPrice
description: Sales API customer-paid amount (finishedPrice). Persisted as wb_sales.revenue. Basis for historical Estimated Tax = Tax% × Σ finishedPrice. Not Commercial Performance Revenue.
formula: Estimated Tax = Tax Rate × Σ finishedPrice

title: forPay
description: Sales API seller-payable per sale (forPay). With Sales derives Marketplace Fee = max(0, Sales − Σ forPay). Stored as wb_sales.for_pay. Differs from Finance ppvz_for_pay.

title: ppvz_for_pay
description: Finance API payable field per transaction. Commercial Performance Revenue = Σ ppvz_for_pay. Stored in wb_finance. Can differ from Sales API forPay.

title: netForPay
description: Settlement-oriented net payable used in Model C where Revenue = netForPay. Distinct from Commercial Performance Revenue.

title: Acquiring Fee
description: Payment acquiring costs (Finance ACQUIRING). Component of marketplace cost presentation.

title: PPVZ VW
description: Finance PPVZ_VW fee component in marketplace cost presentation.

title: PPVZ Reward
description: Finance PPVZ_REWARD component in marketplace cost presentation.

aliases: What is the difference between Sales and Revenue
What is the difference between Sales and Revenue?
title: Sales vs Revenue Distinction
description: Sales (Σ priceWithDisc) is merchandise presentation. Revenue (Σ ppvz_for_pay) is seller payable. Not interchangeable.

title: Units Sold
description: Completed non-return sale units in period from wb_sales (is_return = false).

title: Returned Units and Net Units
description: Returned Units from is_return sales. Net Units = Units Sold minus returns. Distinct from Returned Sales value.

title: Orders KPI
description: Order events from wb_orders by order_date. Distinct from Units Sold (completed buyouts).

title: Buyout
description: Demand-to-sale conversion between orders and completed sales. Chart 'Purchases' label = Buyout, not Purchases module.

title: Profit Margin
description: Ratio from Commercial Performance (Net Profit vs Revenue/Sales per surface). Presentation only.

title: Return Logistics
description: RETURN_LOGISTICS finance category — return shipment costs. Distinct from Returned Sales and forward Logistics.

title: Sale Date vs Finance Settlement Date
description: Sales metrics: sale_date. Finance/Revenue/costs: operation_date. Orders: order_date. Settlement: finance/settlement time. Do not merge date axes.
keywords: which date determines finance settlement reporting

aliases: Why Sales API differs from Finance
title: Sales API vs Finance API Reconciliation
description: Sales forPay and Finance ppvz_for_pay differ by feed/timing/settlement. Revenue uses Finance. Marketplace Fee uses Sales − forPay. State API and date axis when reconciling.
keywords: why can sales api forpay differ

title: Effective Marketplace Cost Presentation
description: Finance presentation: COMMISSION + ACQUIRING + PPVZ_REWARD + PPVZ_VW + OTHER from wb_finance. Separate from Marketplace Fee formula (Sales − forPay).

title: Accounting Rules Framework
description: Canonical accounting framework for money-related calculations and reports. Defines financial models, revenue recognition boundaries, and cost categories.

title: Estimated Tax Dual Model
description: The project intentionally maintains two Estimated Tax bases: historical reporting uses Σ finishedPrice; Smart Pricing uses Sale − Marketplace Fee. Do not unify.

relationships.note: Defines tax dual-model policy for FE-012

exceptions: Smart Pricing: Tax Rate × (Sale − Marketplace Fee)
